newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria brewery shares froth up on BBAG.
newsitem.headline: Austria brewery shares froth up on BBAG.

text.p: Austrian brewery shares rose strongly on Tuesday after brewery holding group Oesterreichische Brau AG (BBAG) forecast a better-than-expected full year pre-tax profit of about one billion schillings.
"It's definitely because of the figures. They're way above market expectations," said one trader.

At 0950 GMT, shares of BBAG were up 1.35 percent at 750 schillings, while its unit Brau Union, through which BBAG earlier said it would take a majority stake in a Romanian brewery, rose 1.82 percent to 672 schillings.
